title: Olive in the Gap
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds j, v, w
note_for_grown_ups: The last Phase 2 sound (l, ll, ss) unlocks words like 'fell' and 'well' here — all 23 Phase 2 sounds are now taught, a nice milestone to celebrate.

pages.illustration: Olive the owl sitting calmly on a log beside the pond on a still day.

pages.text: A pot fell! A cap fell!
pages.illustration: A sudden gust of wind knocking a pot and a cap over near the pond, Olive noticing.
Olive the owl staying alert, watching the wind pick up over the pond.
Olive the owl tucking herself into a sheltered gap between two rocks by the pond.
Olive the owl staying put in the sheltered gap as wind and rain sweep over the pond outside.
The wind and rain easing over the pond, water calming, light returning.

pages.text: Olive got up. Olive did not fuss.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl stepping out of the gap into calm, still air by the pond, settled and unbothered.
